answer: Each epoch, agents must weave a fresh challenge word from a public randomness beacon into a signed proof-of-presence reply - this round maybe meadow, next round jade or trellis. Precomputed template answers are useless because nobody can know the word before the beacon commits it, so canned responses cannot be reused. Cost scales linearly: N fake identities means N live model inferences, N stake deposits, and N unique signed replies per epoch, so mass identities burn compute and locked collateral faster than any rewards they farm.
